title: Codebeamer: Technical Essentials
description: End-to-end Codebeamer ALM workflow - create a project, manage requirements, testing, releases, reports, and documents using the JAWS proof-of-concept scenario.

modules.title: Codebeamer Overview
modules.description: Explore Application Lifecycle Management concepts, discover Codebeamer's architecture and capabilities, and navigate the Codebeamer user interface using the JAWS proof-of-concept scenario.

modules.title: Create a Project and Navigate Trackers
modules.description: Create a Codebeamer project for the JAWS proof-of-concept, configure project administration settings, and explore how trackers, workflows, and configuration diagrams organize project data.

modules.title: Manage Requirements
modules.description: Import requirements, examine traceability, build filtered and intelligent views, manage tracker connections, perform Excel round-trip editing, run reviews, and create baselines for the JAWS proof-of-concept project.

modules.title: Manage Testing
modules.description: Explore Codebeamer's holistic test management capabilities and practice creating, importing, executing, and analyzing tests for the JAWS proof-of-concept project.

modules.title: Manage Releases
modules.description: Explore how Codebeamer supports Agile, Waterfall, and hybrid development methodologies, manage teams and tasks, work with the Kanban board, and create and manage releases and sprints for the JAWS proof-of-concept project.

modules.title: Create Reports and Analyze Project Data
modules.description: Build simple and traceability reports, manage report jobs, and create wiki dashboards to visualize data from the JAWS proof-of-concept project.

modules.title: Manage Documents
modules.description: Use the Codebeamer Document Manager to organize, version, and link supporting documents for the JAWS proof-of-concept project, while wrapping up the Codebeamer Technical Essentials journey.
